pages.title: Swordstep
pages.creator: LMB Studio
pages.description:
Swordstep is a pixel-art puzzle platformer in which one magical sword serves as both a tool and a way to travel. Throw it into a wall to create a foothold, teleport to its position, or recall it when you need it elsewhere. Work upward through the tower to restore the sun.

Fifty levels span five areas, including rooftops, a crystal cave, and a frozen lake. The journey contains 150 stars to find, plus eighteen characters and nine swords to unlock. Each obstacle asks you to think about where the blade should go before deciding how to follow it.

pages.title: Glowline Pipes
pages.creator: KoyoTap LLC
pages.description: Rotate pipe tiles to route colored light in Glowline Pipes. Trace each signal through the board and bring red and blue together when you need a purple stream. Play through the handcrafted campaign or take on the daily puzzle. If a connection stalls, use a hint to get the route moving again.

pages.title: Arrow Count Master
pages.creator: Raccoon
pages.description: Build up an arrow volley as you run in Arrow Count Master. Swipe sideways to choose gates that add arrows, multiply the volley, or give it a boost. Look ahead for gates that subtract from your total and for obstacles that can spoil a good route. Try to finish with as many arrows as you can.

pages.title: GenFire
pages.creator: Erman Games
pages.description: Fight elemental creatures from every direction in GenFire. Move through the arena, keep firing, and collect coins as you survive waves of enemies. Fire slimes can split, so keep watching where they were even after a hit. The campaign has 20 levels, with tougher enemies and bosses as you progress.

pages.title: Eat Donuts
pages.creator: SecGame
pages.description: Make matches on a three-by-three board of doughnuts in Eat Donuts. Swap and rotate the rings to set up a match, and keep an eye on the score target for the level. Earn coins along the way and spend them on tools like the hammer when a ring blocks the move you need.

pages.title: Merge Fruit
pages.creator: Albayoo
pages.description: Drag fruit onto the board in Merge Fruit. Put two of the same kind together to make a larger fruit, then use it to set up another merge. Look for a place that keeps the next pair within reach and leaves space on the board. Keep combining pieces to see how large a fruit you can make.

pages.title: Tap To Color: Painting Book
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Color illustrations one area at a time in Tap To Color: Painting Book. Choose a picture and tap its sections to add color. You can see the design take shape as you fill in the smaller areas around the main subject. Try another illustration when you're ready for a new picture.

pages.title: Pipe Puzzle: Connect & Flow
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Rotate pipe pieces in Pipe Puzzle: Connect & Flow to make an unbroken route for the water. Follow the connections from the starting point and check which open ends still need to meet. Finish the route to unlock another puzzle, or use a hint when you can't see how the pieces should fit.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Legend
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Aim and fire bubbles into the cluster in Bubble Shooter Legend. A shot clears bubbles when it joins at least three of the same color. Look at where your bubble will touch the group and use matches to open up new targets. Clear the board to work through the levels.

pages.title: TB Avataria Life Girl
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Furnish an empty home in TB Avataria Life Girl. Use the computer's money-making app to earn spending money, then choose between furniture and new clothes. Keep track of hunger while you decorate. A trip to the café lets your character eat before you go back to earning or shopping.

pages.title: Kinder Garden
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Look after babies in Kinder Garden while building up your daycare. Feed them and change their diapers when they need attention, then put your earnings toward toys, upgrades, and more rooms. Check which baby needs help first as you go between tasks and grow the nursery.

pages.title: Sprunki Puzzles and Singing
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Unlock a cast of sixteen characters in Sprunki Puzzles and Singing. Each portrait starts as nine scrambled squares. Swap the pieces until the picture is complete, then move on to another Sprunki. After you've finished the portraits, use the characters you've unlocked to start making music.

pages.title: 2048 Puzzle: Connect the Balls
pages.creator: AdelikDev
pages.description: Aim and shoot numbered balls in 2048 Puzzle: Connect the Balls. Look for matching numbers and line up a shot that brings them together. Save the bombs for balls you need to clear out of the way, and use the space you recover to keep making matches and building your score.

pages.title: Merge the Coins USSR!
pages.creator: IT-Hype
pages.description: Drop coins into the playing area in Merge the Coins USSR! Two identical coins fuse when they meet, giving you a larger coin and a chance to build toward the next one. Think about where each coin will land so you can link up more pairs and raise your score.

pages.title: Fill The Bottle
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Guide balls into containers of different shapes in Fill The Bottle. Work out how to fit them into the available space while keeping the pile below the marked line. A layout that works for a wide container may leave unused space in a narrow one, so look at the shape before you start.

pages.title: Jeli2D
pages.creator: IT-Hype
pages.description: Use the way pieces move and settle to your advantage in Jeli2D. Bring matching jellies together to form a larger piece, and look for placements that set up another merge. Try to grow the biggest jelly while keeping the game going. Boosters can help when the board gets difficult to manage.

pages.title: Summer Spotlight Differences
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Compare pairs of summer scenes in Summer Spotlight Differences. Find the five details that change between the pictures to open the next level. Check one part of the scene at a time, paying attention to small changes in the background as well as the objects that catch your eye first.

pages.title: Hunted Wolf Defense Game
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Get your defenses ready before dark in Hunted Wolf Defense Game. Upgrade your shelter and increase coin production so you can afford to hold out against the wolf. Use bombs to fight back when enemies threaten your position, and decide where each upgrade will make the biggest difference before the next attack.

pages.title: Super Snappy Boomguys
pages.creator: Gamebop
pages.description: Throw bombs and try to outlast your opponents in Super Snappy Boomguys. Move away from blasts and collect power-ups when you spot a chance to grab one. Play with friends or compete in the weekly tournament. A well-placed bomb can cut off another player's route while you look for your own way out.

pages.title: Pixel Combat Multiplayer
pages.creator: AngryGamez
pages.description: Take a pixel-styled weapon into an online match in Pixel Combat Multiplayer. Fight for yourself in Deathmatch or work with a team in Team Deathmatch. The block-built maps give you different angles and routes to learn, and the weapon selection gives you options as you move between fights.

pages.title: Solitaire Classic - Klondike
pages.creator: SUN.STUDIO
pages.description: Build suit piles from ace to king in Solitaire Classic - Klondike. Move cards between columns in descending order and alternate colors to uncover the face-down cards beneath them. Check what a move will reveal before using an empty column, and draw new cards when the board runs out of useful moves.

pages.title: Dinosaur Eggs Pop
pages.creator: SUN.STUDIO
pages.description: Help a dinosaur clear clusters of eggs in Dinosaur Eggs Pop. Shoot an egg into a group of the same color to pop three or more together. Swap the available bubbles when another color gives you a better angle, and watch for flying dinosaurs you can shoot along the way.

pages.title: Unicycle Mayhem
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Balance on one wheel while trying to knock down your rival in Unicycle Mayhem. Shoot the floor under the other rider to break it apart and make them fall. Keep moving when your own footing starts to disappear. The match goes to the first rider to score five, and you can share a keyboard with a friend.

pages.title: Clash Of Dots
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Take over red areas in Clash Of Dots by sending attacks out from your green territory. Drag to choose where to attack, and pay attention to the cooldown on each area before making your move. You have two special skills to draw on when an attack stalls or an enemy puts your territory under pressure.

pages.title: Break MANY Bricks
pages.creator: Poly Games
pages.description: Send a ball back into rows of bricks in Break MANY Bricks. Use the mouse or touchscreen to move the paddle under the ball before it drops. Try to bounce it into parts of the layout that still have bricks, and adjust your position as gaps change where the ball comes back.

pages.title: Cupsaga
pages.creator: Ramblo Digital Media
pages.description: Follow the cup that hides the ball in Cupsaga. Keep your eye on it through the shuffle and tap the cup you think the ball is under once the cups stop moving. Correct guesses lead to faster, longer shuffles, so it's worth tracking the cup from the first move of each round.

pages.title: Farming Missions 2023
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Take heavy machinery around a farming village in Farming Missions 2023. Carry loads in mission mode, race construction vehicles to the finish, or explore at your own pace in free drive. Many modes support two players. The first driver steers with WASD and the second uses the arrow keys.

pages.title: Rope Master
pages.creator: XTStudio
pages.description: Separate overlapping ropes in Rope Master. Move the rope and look at how the crossings change after each adjustment. The puzzle ends when the strands are untangled. Follow one rope across the board to see which crossing you can remove first without getting it tangled somewhere else.

pages.title: Crafty Miner
pages.creator: Andy Games
pages.description: Dig for minerals in Crafty Miner and sell what you bring back. Use the proceeds to get a stronger pickaxe or hire workers, then head deeper to look for rarer resources. Each new tier gives you more to dig for, so decide where an upgrade will save you the most work.

pages.title: Halloween Bubble Shooter
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Shoot into clusters of colorful monsters in Halloween Bubble Shooter. Match at least three of a color to clear them, and look for shots that open up the next part of the cluster. Aim and click on a computer, or drag to aim and release to shoot on a touchscreen. Try to clear the board in few shots.

pages.title: Red Light Green Light
pages.creator: Mad Buffer
pages.description: Run toward the finish in Red Light Green Light while the girl is facing away. When she turns around and the light changes, stop before you're spotted. Use the mouse or touchscreen to control your direction. Get across the line before time runs out, leaving yourself room to stop on red.

pages.title: MazeX
pages.creator: PKPL Entertainment
pages.description: Work your way out of retro 2D labyrinths in MazeX. Swipe or tap to move through the passages. Read the layout ahead of you and change course when a corridor leads to a dead end. Each level gives you a different maze to work through on your own.

pages.title: Fallen Figures
pages.creator: kidsgamesplay
pages.description: Shoot falling shapes in Fallen Figures before they reach the bottom. Aim with the mouse or slide on a touchscreen to sweep across the screen as figures come down. You can miss only ten, so prioritize shapes close to the bottom and take advantage of bonuses that slow the fall.

pages.title: Pop Us 3D!
pages.creator: vetx
pages.description: Pick a 3D fidget toy in Pop Us 3D! and press its bubbles one by one. Click or tap your way around shapes such as a heart, rocket, lobster, or pineapple. Look over the toy for bubbles you missed, then pick a different shape when you want a new arrangement.

pages.title: Witch Beauty Salon
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Give four witches their own looks in Witch Beauty Salon. Tap through the makeover options and see how the changes look together on each character. Try a new combination when you switch witches, or keep one feature you like while you experiment with the rest.

pages.title: Penguin Dive
pages.creator: Go Game Pte Ltd
pages.description: Dive for fish in Penguin Dive and steer clear of jellyfish on the way down. Use A and D or the left and right arrows to move on a keyboard, or slide sideways on a touchscreen. Upgrade your pickups between dives to give yourself an advantage the next time you head underwater.

pages.title: Zorb Battle
pages.creator: allviralgames
pages.description: Swipe to roll around the arena in Zorb Battle. Collect growth bubbles to get bigger and power bubbles to get stronger, then use your size to knock opponents into the water. Steer away from larger rivals until you have enough room and strength to make a push of your own.

pages.title: Among Impostor Collapse
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Clear groups of two or more matching characters in Among Impostor Collapse. Bigger groups score more points, and clearing at least six together earns a bomb. Check how the characters are arranged before clicking. A small group can be worth leaving in place if you can build it into a larger match.

pages.title: No One Escape
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Slip past the killer and open the exit in No One Escape. Drag to move around the rooms, staying out of the killer's sight as you work your way to the buttons. The gate opens once all the buttons are green. Find a route to the exit before the killer catches you.

pages.title: Monkey Teacher
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Practice drawing geometric figures with Monkey Teacher. Look at the figure on screen, then draw its outline. Pay attention to where the edges change direction and how the lines join. Each new shape gives you another chance to practice drawing a figure with the mouse or touchscreen.

pages.title: Happy Family Puzzle
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Reassemble illustrations of family life in Happy Family Puzzle. Choose from twelve scenes and use the mouse or touchscreen to fit each piece into the picture. Start with a recognizable detail or an edge, then use the surrounding colors and shapes to find the pieces that connect to it.

pages.title: Stunts Car Challenge
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Take a car over sloped tracks in Stunts Car Challenge. Drive with WASD or the arrow keys and use space to brake. Try to cover each slope to improve your score. Ease off the speed as you come to a sharp corner so you can line up for the next section.

pages.title: Magic Stones Collection
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Trace chains of matching stones in Magic Stones Collection. Drag through at least three neighbors of the same kind, including diagonal neighbors, and release to collect them. Aim for the stones the level asks for before time runs out. Longer chains can earn bonuses, including more time for chains of eight or more.

pages.title: Deer Hunting Sniper Shooting
pages.creator: mastergame
pages.description: Head into a forest hunting course in Deer Hunting Sniper Shooting. Control the hunter with the arrow keys as you look for deer and line up shots. Take time to get the target in view before firing. The game presents the hunt from a first-person perspective.

pages.title: Rolly Legs
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Race a transforming robot in Rolly Legs. Press and hold to use its legs on climbs and obstacles, then let it roll when the course opens up. Look at the terrain ahead to decide which way to move. Get through the track before the other racers to take first place.

pages.title: Deadly Hunter
pages.creator: JZJO.COM
pages.description: Free your friends and face a tiger in Deadly Hunter. Move around obstacles as you work your way through the course, and steer toward the friends you can rescue along the way. Watch where you're moving so you can get the group past the obstacles and reach the tiger.

pages.title: Horror Hospital Escape Granny Game
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description: Search for a way out in Horror Hospital Escape Granny Game. Follow the in-game prompts as you explore and look for keys that can open up the route. The escape follows a young woman trying to confront her nightmares, with a companion who stays with her as the story continues.

pages.title: Virus Cards Memory
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Flip cards and remember where the virus illustrations are in Virus Cards Memory. Use the mouse to turn over two at a time and remove them when they match. Clear every pair before the timer runs out. As the layouts get harder, use the cards you've already seen to avoid spending time on blind guesses.

pages.title: Word Search Pictures
pages.creator: akiwy OU
pages.description: Find words hidden among letter blocks in Word Search Pictures. Swipe across letters to build an answer and see what drops away when you get it right. Solve the words on each board to open later puzzles. Take your time on harder boards or try the daily and hourly challenges.

pages.title: Surze
pages.creator: Vedia Games
pages.description: Search a school for trapped children in Surze. Move with WASD and use the mouse to look around as you try to stay clear of the creature in the building. Get the children to safety and find the bus key so you can leave the school.

pages.title: Earn FREE Credits in IMVU 2020
pages.creator: yaine
pages.description: Spin a ten-section wheel in Earn FREE Credits in IMVU 2020. Start a round and watch the wheel slow to a stop to see which segment the pointer lands on. The segments display different results, including point values and additional spins.

pages.title: Castle Slot
pages.creator: Game-Devs
pages.description: Set a bet and choose your paylines in Castle Slot, then spin the reels to see where the symbols land. Consult the paytable to see which combinations pay out. A winning spin gives you the option to risk the virtual coins on a double-or-nothing round or keep the payout you already have.

pages.title: Rocket Racer
pages.creator: Fat Boy Studio
pages.description: Steer your rocket between walls in Rocket Racer. Use A and D or the arrow keys to move left and right, and aim for power-ups when you have a clear route to them. Each pickup can change what your rocket can do as you try to survive longer and raise your score.

pages.title: Target Hunt
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Take aim at the shooting range in Target Hunt. Click or tap the targets to score, and look for the next one as soon as you've taken a shot. Try to keep your aim steady as you move between targets. Compare your score with your previous runs and see whether you can set a new best.

pages.title: Cops N Robbers Memory
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Find matching pictures of cops and robbers in Cops N Robbers Memory. Turn over two tiles with a click or tap and remember where the pictures are when they don't match. Clear every pair in each of four levels and try to do it with as few flips as possible.

pages.title: BTS Music Instrument Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Color drawings of instruments in BTS Music Instrument Coloring Book. Use the mouse or tap the picture to work on the instruments and the space around them. Try contrasting colors for different parts of an instrument, or carry the same set of colors across the whole picture.

pages.title: Cute Gnomes Hidden Stars
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Search scenes with gnomes for hidden stars in Cute Gnomes Hidden Stars. Each of the six pictures has ten stars to find before time expires. Click or tap when you've located one, since repeated wrong guesses cost five seconds. Look across the scene in sections if the last stars are hard to spot.

pages.title: CAD War 4
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Take on another hostage rescue in CAD War 4 after a hostile group seizes several settlements. Move with WASD, aim with the right mouse button, and fire with the left. Press R to reload and E to interact. Keep track of where you're exposed as you advance toward the hostages.

pages.title: Lone Pistol : Zombies in the Streets
pages.creator: QiGames Studio
pages.description: Hold your ground against waves of zombies in Lone Pistol : Zombies in the Streets. Tap to shoot at the attackers and tap near your character to reload. Keep an eye on the closest zombies before you spend a moment reloading. Try to keep the street clear as the next wave arrives.

pages.title: Kids Coloring Bakery
pages.creator: IG
pages.description: Pick a bakery drawing in Kids Coloring Bakery and color it with the mouse. Work on cakes, doughnuts, cupcakes, or cookies, and use the outlines to keep track of the areas you want to fill. Give a treat the colors you'd use for its frosting, or come up with a combination of your own.

pages.title: Draw and Guess Multiplayer
pages.creator: Lomboos
pages.description: Draw a prompt or guess what another player is sketching in Draw and Guess Multiplayer. Use the mouse or your finger to draw, and enter guesses on the onscreen keyboard. Play with friends or other players, practice a drawing on your own, or try the Daily Challenge for the Artist of the Day title.

pages.title: Chicken Jump
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Get a running chicken across platforms in Chicken Jump. Use the mouse or touchscreen to jump, watching for obstacles and aiming for diamonds when they're within reach. Get your timing down as the platforms change, then carry what you've learned into the next of the twelve levels.

pages.title: Foxi Mini Car Parking 2019 Car Driving Test
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Drive into the marked parking area in Foxi Mini Car Parking 2019 Car Driving Test. Use WASD to steer and space to brake. Leave yourself room to straighten up as you approach the space. A slow final turn gives you more control over where the car comes to a stop.

pages.title: Wings Rush
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Roll, jump, and flap past obstacles in Wings Rush. Keep your hedgehog moving along the track and through the clouds while you gather rings. Use the rings to unlock other characters and try another run with them. Look ahead as the route changes so you can react before an obstacle reaches you.

pages.title: Sniper 3D Assassin online
pages.creator: fugames
pages.description: Take on assignments as an agent in Sniper 3D Assassin online. Use the right mouse button to look through the scope, adjust the zoom with the wheel, and fire with the left button. Complete shots to earn coins and spend them in the shop on more advanced rifles.

pages.title: Airplane Flying Simulator
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Fly a passenger plane through waypoints in Airplane Flying Simulator. Follow the route to the correct airport and get the aircraft down before the mission timer expires. Use the mouse and arrow keys to fly. Pass each waypoint as you go so the final approach counts toward completing the flight.

pages.title: Blocky Snakes
pages.creator: BeedoGames
pages.description: Grow a snake in the 3D arena of Blocky Snakes. Steer toward collectibles and power-ups while watching for other snakes that can get in your way. Move with the mouse in the regular view and click for a boost. In the overhead view, use A and D or the arrow keys to steer.

pages.title: Street Shooter
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Take jump shots from five spots on the court in Street Shooter. Flick the ball toward the basket and use the result to judge the aim and strength of the next shot. You have 60 seconds to score as often as you can. Check your accuracy at the end of the round.

pages.title: Space Speed
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Rush through a colorful tunnel in Space Speed and steer away from the shapes blocking your route. Tap the left or right side, or use the arrow keys, to move out of the way. Look beyond the nearest obstacle so you can line up for the next opening as it comes toward you.

pages.title: Peguin Adventure
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Run through platforming levels in Peguin Adventure. Jump over hazards or slide when the route calls for it, and keep an eye out for enemies ahead. Work your way to the end of each section and carry on to the next level, using the two moves to get past what blocks your path.

pages.title: Princess Holiday Party
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Solve puzzles with Emma before she heads off on holiday in Princess Holiday Party. Use the mouse to work through the activities, then help her get ready for the celebration. Look through the outfits and choose what she'll wear for the party after the puzzle section.

pages.title: Acid Sink
pages.creator: Supernapie
pages.description: Climb to safety in Acid Sink by jumping off the walls as the acid rises. Use the shape of the chamber to plan where each jump should take you. Look for a swimsuit pickup, which lets you swim through acid, and keep moving toward the top to reach the next level.

pages.title: Boat Simulator
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Take one of four boats out on the water in Boat Simulator. Choose a vessel and practice steering it as you move across the water. Try another boat to see how its response differs when you turn or change speed. The focus is on controlling the craft as you explore.

pages.title: Ludo Legend
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Roll the die and race your tokens home in Ludo Legend. A six gets a token out of its starting area, and each roll gives you a choice of which token to move. Landing on a rival can send it back to the start. Play alone or pass one device between friends.

pages.title: Warriors League
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Lead a group of heroes into battle in Warriors League. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, use Z or the left mouse button to attack, and press X or space for a special move. Switch heroes with C or the number keys to change who takes the lead as you fight through the kingdom.

pages.title: Galactic Safari
pages.creator: Ebuzzgames
pages.description: Take on waves of alien ships in Galactic Safari. Move your ship out of the way of enemy fire while you shoot through the formation. Collect coins and watch for power-ups as you go. Bigger ships have their own attacks, so keep an eye on the incoming fire when a boss appears.

pages.title: Fruit Escape: Draw Line
pages.creator: ALMA Games
pages.description: Draw a line to guide fruit into a portal in Fruit Escape: Draw Line. Watch how the fruit moves when it meets your drawing, then change the shape of the line to get around an obstacle or redirect a fall. Each layout asks you to find a route that works with the physics.

pages.title: Tower Defense
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Protect the route from enemy attacks in Tower Defense. Place defenses along the path to intercept the units coming through. Look at bends and longer stretches when choosing a position, since the placement determines when your towers can engage. Use the available spaces to cover as much of the approach as you can.

pages.title: The Office Guy
pages.creator: Freak X Games
pages.description: Fight your way through a corrupt workplace in The Office Guy. Read the objective at the start of each of ten tasks, then move through the office with the arrow keys. Use space to swing the bat or attack with weapons you pick up. Find the briefcase at the end to finish the game.

pages.title: Winter Looks
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Style the featured princess for different winter settings in Winter Looks. Change her hairstyle and try cold-weather outfits to see which pieces work together. Make a look for one location, then try a different combination when the setting changes. You can give each scene its own style.

pages.title: Pirate Girl Creator
pages.creator: Missangest Games
pages.description: Make a pirate of your own in Pirate Girl Creator. Dress her as a new member of the crew or outfit her as the captain, then choose the gear she takes to sea. Pick an environment for the finished character, from a quiet stretch of water to a storm.

pages.title: Robo Battle
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Guide a robot through dangerous levels in Robo Battle. Fight enemy robots and watch for lasers and saws as you make your way through. Think about which threats you can attack and which ones you need to get past. Time your movements to reach the other side of each obstacle.

pages.title: Cinderella Red Carpet Collection
pages.creator: MyCuteGames
pages.description: Prepare Cinderella, Aurora, and Jasmine for a runway show in Cinderella Red Carpet Collection. Choose runway makeup for each model, then put together an outfit from Cinderella's red carpet designs. Give each princess a distinct look or coordinate their styles before they step onto the runway together.

pages.title: Princess Memory Matching
pages.creator: Yolkgames
pages.description: Match pairs of princess cards in Princess Memory Matching. Turn over cards and remember which princess is in each spot, then use what you've seen to make a pair. Try to clear the board quickly by returning to a card you've already uncovered when you find its match.

pages.title: Forest Village Getaway Episode 1
pages.creator: Snapbreak Games AB
pages.description: Explore a medieval settlement in Forest Village Getaway Episode 1. Click around the village to find objects and clues, then use what you collect to open locks and solve puzzles. Check behind containers and other objects as you search. A detail in one part of the village can help you somewhere else.

pages.title: Longcat Journey
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Guide a stretchy cat toward fish in Longcat Journey. Work around the platforms and collect fish to make the cat longer. As it grows, think about how much room its body needs to get past an obstacle. Use the layout to work out a route to the next fish.

pages.title: Battleship War
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Hide your fleet and search for the opposing ships in Battleship War. Pick grid squares to fire on, then use hits and misses to narrow down where each vessel could be. After a hit, check nearby squares to work out which way the ship extends. Sink the opposing fleet to win.

pages.title: Vintage Wedding
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Find the missing items in Vintage Wedding before choosing what the bride will wear. Search the room first, then try the wedding dresses and pick shoes and jewelry to go with the one you like. The game gives you a hidden-object task to complete before the dress-up part begins.
